evidence: Added new field "Score" with type Number via Configure Fields dialog; it appeared as a new column "Score" in the table view immediately with "—" placeholder for existing entries.
Added entry "Write test cases" with Priority=5, Due Date=Sep 1, 2026, Completed=Yes, Score=42. Values displayed correctly in both table row and card view.
Switched from table to card view; all 6 entries and their field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Score) remained identical between views.

Configure Fields dialog shows a labeled type dropdown with icon+text options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. Add Entry form renders a textbox for Text, a spinbutton for Number, a date input for Date, and a toggle checkbox for Checkbox fields.

In the Add Entry form, the Completed checkbox toggled between "No" (unchecked icon) and "Yes" (checked icon, distinct icon+color). In table and card views, Completed cells show distinct icon plus "Yes"/"No" text for each entry.

Priority/Score fields render as native number inputs (type=number). Attempting to type non-numeric text "abc" into the Priority field was rejected by the browser input itself (Playwright error: "Cannot type text into input[type=number]"), so non-numeric values cannot be entered or saved.

Due Date field renders as a native date input (type=date). Attempting to enter an invalid date "2026-13-45" was rejected at the input level (Playwright error: "Malformed value"), preventing invalid dates from being saved.

Set Table view sort to Priority descending (5,3,2,2,1,1) and Card view sort to Due Date ascending (Jan14,15,18,20,25,Sep1). Switching back to Table view retained its own Priority-descending sort, confirming independent per-view sort state.
Sorting by Priority ascending then descending only reordered rows; entry count stayed at 6 and all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Score) were unchanged across sorts.

Selecting "Priority" from the Sort menu immediately reordered entries; the Sort button label changed to "Priority" and a footer status displayed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)"/"(descending)" reflecting the active field and direction. App remained interactive after sorting.

With sort cleared, used keyboard drag (Space+Arrow+Space) to reorder rows in Table view (swapped "Design new landing page"/"Review marketing materials") and independently reordered Cards view (moved "Update API documentation" up). Switching back to Table view retained its own manual order (Review marketing materials, Design new landing page, Update API documentation, Prepare quarterly report, Team sync meeting notes, Write test cases), distinct from the Card view's order, confirming per-view manual ordering.

actual: Inspected the entire toolbar (Fields, Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry, Search) and all column headers via DOM; no "Filter" button, icon, or per-field filter UI exists anywhere in the app. The word "filter" does not appear in the rendered DOM at all. Only Quick Search (text substring match) and Sort are available; there is no way to define field-specific filter criteria (e.g., number range, checkbox state, date range) to show only matching entries.

issue: No filter feature exists to test inclusion/clearing behavior
actual: No filter UI is present in the application (confirmed via DOM inspection - no filter button, icon, or panel). Since field-specific filtering cannot be configured, filtering behavior (matching entries, clearing to restore all) cannot be exercised or verified.

evidence: Typing "MARKETING" (uppercase) into the search box filtered results to "1 entry matching \"MARKETING\"" showing only "Review marketing materials" (case-insensitive substring match). Clicking the clear (x) button emptied the search box and restored all 6 entries.

issue: Quick search matches only raw internal values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching "Jan 15" (the displayed Due Date format) returned 0 entries, while searching the raw ISO value "2026-01-15" correctly matched the "Design new landing page" entry. Similarly, searching "Yes" (the displayed Completed checkbox state) returned 0 entries despite 3 entries showing "Yes". Search therefore only matches internal raw field values, not the user-visible formatted date or checkbox text.

evidence: All 6 entries and their field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Score) are displayed consistently in both Table and Card views. Empty Score values are shown as a clear "—" placeholder in both the table cell and the card field row for every entry lacking a Score value.

issue: New entries and field/schema changes are not persisted across page reload
actual: Created entry "Write test cases" (visible immediately, entry count went 5→6) and added a "Score" field. After reloading the page (http://localhost:6074/), the app reverted to the original 5 seed entries with no "Score" field and no "Write test cases" entry. All added data, field configuration, sort state, and manual reorder were lost — state exists only in memory, not persisted (e.g., no localStorage/backend save).

issue: No import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire UI (toolbar, Configure Fields dialog, and full DOM) for an import control. No import button, file input, or drag-and-drop import area exists anywhere. The only reference to "import" is a static note in the Configure Fields dialog ("Configure fields before importing data"), but no actual import functionality is implemented, so data cannot be imported or validated against the field schema.
